ItemID: NA; Title: Someone To Watch Over Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Familiar vocal standards sound appealing, but I would prioritize a group vocal album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Songs From The Silver Screen; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for movie songs right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Forte; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal-group direction interests me, but I am not curious enough to try it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Christmas With Scotty McCreery; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Christmas listening was clustered around the holidays; that does not make country Christmas music a current priority.
ItemID: NA; Title: You Should Dream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal harmonies could suit my recent listening, but I would only try one album this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: 21 Number Ones; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A greatest-hits title alone gives me little reason to expect the vocal sound I want.
ItemID: NA; Title: Together; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot tell enough from this title to commit my limited listening time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Celtic Thunder; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Group vocals appeal to me, though I am less interested in a Celtic direction today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lead With Your Heart; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The vocal-harmony focus feels closest to what I enjoyed about The New Old Fashioned, so this is my one pick.
ItemID: NA; Title: Buon Natale: The Christmas Album; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my past holiday listening, but I am not seeking another Christmas album right now.
